_meta.description: Every inner way the game offers, with the panel line each Inner Way Breakthrough rank (the app's tier) unlocks and the value that line has at each character breakthrough. DEV-ONLY reference data: never import this from src/ or tests/ (see docs/REFERENCE-DATA.md). Copy values into src/data/innerWays/ by hand.
_meta.source: Where Winds Meet oversea client, LocalData/Patch/HD/oversea bin tables xinfa, xinfa_uprank_info, xinfa_uprank_world_lv and xinfa_uprank_attr, plus translate_words_map_en for the names, as installed 2026-09-03.
_meta.generator: reference-inner-ways.js in the sibling wwm-data workspace folder (D:/Projects/wwm/wwm-data/tools), which is not part of this repo. If that folder is gone, regenerating means decoding the client tables again; the container format is described in that folder's README.
howToRead: id is the game's inner way id, the same number the dashboard passive ids in src/data/innerWays/passiveIds.ts use.

lines lists every panel line the inner way grants, each with the Inner Way Breakthrough rank (tier N in the app) that unlocks it: byBreakthrough is a line that scales with the character breakthrough, fixed is a line that never changes.

byBreakthrough is keyed by the app's breakthrough number, which is the game's world level. The client resolves each world level to a table row (world levels 10 and 11 share one); the values here are already resolved per breakthrough.

Keys are the app's panel-stat paths where one exists (phys.max, precision, critRate, affinityRate, physBoost, directCritRate, directAffinityRate, affinityDamageBoost, critDamageBoost, attributeDamageBoost, <attribute>.min/max/penetration). Attribute blocks: bellstrike, stonesplit, silkbind, bamboocut; a class's own block is what the app writes as primaryAttr.
Rates and boosts are fractions (0.072 = 7.2 %). Penetration is already divided by 100 to the app's unit (the game shows 5.1 points, the app stores 0.051).
Lines with a game column name (HP_MAX, W_DEF, W_DEF_SCALE, W_HEAL_SCALE, HEAL_CRI_UP, W_ATK_PEN_RDC, ACTIVE_PRO_ATK, ACTIVE_PRO_PEN) have no app stat yet and keep the game's name and unit.
school is the class whose inner-way pool the game files this under; 'any' is the shared pool. Unlisted liupai ids are classes the app does not model.

greyLines appears only where the client's __grey tables (the staged rollout variant a server flag switches on) differ from the normal tables; check in game which variant is live before copying either.
